import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
V=np.var(dA_dt)
forms={
 'lin_decl': (lambda p,t: p[0]+p[1]*(1-np.exp(-p[2]*t))-p[3]*t, [2,4,1,0.05]),
 'bump_exp': (lambda p,t: p[0]+p[1]*(1-np.exp(-p[2]*t))+p[3]*t*np.exp(-p[4]*t), [2,5,1,1,0.1]),
 'powbump': (lambda p,t: p[0]+p[1]*t**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*t), [2,6,0.5,0.1]),
 'sat_tdecay': (lambda p,t: p[0]*t/(p[1]+t)*np.exp(-p[2]*t)+p[3], [6,1,0.02,1]),
 'sat_minus_exp': (lambda p,t: p[0]*(1-np.exp(-p[1]*t))-p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*t), [7,0.6,6,0.1]),
 'hill_decay': (lambda p,t: p[0]*t**p[1]/(p[2]**p[1]+t**p[1])*np.exp(-p[3]*t)+p[4], [6,2,1,0.02,1]),
 'sqrt_form': (lambda p,t: p[0]*np.sqrt(t)*np.exp(-p[1]*t)+p[2]*(1-np.exp(-p[3]*t)) , [5,0.1,1,1]),
 'log_form': (lambda p,t: p[0]*np.log(1+p[1]*t)/(1+p[2]*t)+p[3], [5,1,0.05,1]),
}
for name,(f,p0) in forms.items():
    def model(p,t,A):
        a=f(p[:len(p0)],t)
        b=p[-2]*np.exp(-p[-1]*t)
        return a+b*A**3
    pp=list(p0)+[0.17,0.095]
    try:
        r=least_squares(lambda p: model(p,t,A)-dA_dt, pp, method='lm', max_nfev=5000)
        print(name, "NMSE %.3e"%(np.mean(r.fun**2)/V), np.round(r.x,4))
    except Exception as e:
        print(name,"fail",e)
